rounds.settings_quota_description: Free accounts and guests: up to 10 server operations per day and files up to 50 MB each. Paid web tools: no daily operation cap and files up to 500 MB each. Batch limits: Up to 100 files for Merge, JPG/PNG to PDF, and Scan to PDF. Compare takes two PDFs. Photo Merge takes 2–12 images.
